summary: Marker merge apply requires a real persisted 3-way base, writes timestamped backups, and refuses missing-base apply; safe import-payload only honors manifest overwrite when destination hash matches the last apply ledger (#1477).
migration_impact: Run `gh plate import-payload --apply` (or call `record_marker_merge_bases`) once before the first `--apply-markers` if bases were never recorded. Safe re-import no longer overwrites customized labels/templates unless content still matches the last import hash.
